summary: A finished runtime start marks what it changed and wakes the reconciler before it stops counting as running, so nothing that waited for the start goes on without that wake

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: The start's result is persisted first, as before. Only the order of its last three steps changes: mark the subject, wake the reconciler, then leave the set of running starts. The waiter is the test-support single-pass path. The real loop does not wait, so in production the only effect is that a pass woken by the completion may still see the start in that set briefly, and a finished start is never treated as orphaned.

recovery.detail: An older build leaves the set first.
